  `id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `tenant_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `drive_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `upload_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `target_node_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_parent_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `target_name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_node_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_revision_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `result_blob_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `input_fingerprint` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `cleanup_pending` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `cleanup_attempts` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `cleanup_available_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `cleanup_last_reason` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `protocol` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'tus',
  `status` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'initiated',
  `expected_sha256` char(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `total_size_bytes` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `received_bytes` bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `chunk_size` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  `mime_type` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `parts` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `assembled_blob_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `metadata` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `expires_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_by` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `custom_upload_sessions_upload_id_uniq` (`upload_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_cleanup_idx` (`status`,`cleanup_pending`,`cleanup_available_at`,`id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_drive_idx` (`drive_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_tenant_id_index` (`tenant_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_drive_id_index` (`drive_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_target_node_id_index` (`target_node_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_target_parent_id_index` (`target_parent_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_result_node_id_index` (`result_node_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_result_revision_id_index` (`result_revision_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_result_blob_id_index` (`result_blob_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_assembled_blob_id_index` (`assembled_blob_id`),
  KEY `custom_upload_sessions_sweeper_idx` (`status`,`expires_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `custom_upload_sessions_drive_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`drive_id`) REFERENCES `custom_drives` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `custom_upload_sessions_result_blob_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`result_blob_id`) REFERENCES `custom_blobs` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `custom_upload_sessions_chk_1` CHECK ((`cleanup_pending` in (false,true))),
  CONSTRAINT `custom_upload_sessions_chk_2` CHECK (((`cleanup_attempts` is null) or (`cleanup_attempts` >= 0)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

custom_webhook_deliveries.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `custom_webhook_deliveries` (
  `id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `endpoint_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `event` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `payload` json NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `attempts` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `next_retry_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `claim_token` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `claim_until` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_error` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `event_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `custom_webhook_deliveries_event_endpoint_unique` (`event_id`,`endpoint_id`),
  KEY `custom_webhook_deliveries_retry_idx` (`status`,`next_retry_at`),
  KEY `custom_webhook_deliveries_prune_idx` (`status`,`updated_at`),
  KEY `custom_webhook_deliveries_endpoint_id_index` (`endpoint_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `custom_webhook_deliveries_endpoint_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`endpoint_id`) REFERENCES `custom_webhook_endpoints` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

custom_webhook_endpoints.create_sql:
CREATE TABLE `custom_webhook_endpoints` (
  `id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `url` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `events` json NOT NULL,
  `signing_secret` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `previous_signing_secret` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  `previous_secret_expires_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `last_triggered_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `failure_count` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `failing_since` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `disabled_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `disabled_reason` varchar(32) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `updated_at` timestamp NULL DEFAULT NULL,
  `tenant_id` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `drive_id` char(36) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `custom_webhook_endpoints_active_tenant_idx` (`is_active`,`tenant_id`),
  KEY `custom_webhook_endpoints_is_active_index` (`is_active`),
  KEY `custom_webhook_endpoints_tenant_id_index` (`tenant_id`),
  KEY `custom_webhook_endpoints_drive_id_index` (`drive_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `custom_webhook_endpoints_drive_id_foreign` FOREIGN KEY (`drive_id`) REFERENCES `custom_drives` (`id`) ON DELETE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
